pair_required: This phone is not connected. Ask for a new QR code on the computer.
no_messages: Nothing here yet. Tap the microphone and speak.
waiting_connection: It will go out when the connection is back.
edit_hint: The original stays in the app's history
delete_hint: The original stays in the app's history.
failed_hint: Transcription failed. The audio is kept on the computer.
offline_long: The computer does not answer. Check that it is on and on the same network.
lan_blocked: The computer refused the connection: it accepts the local network only.
silent_hint: There is no speech in this recording, only noise. The audio is kept on the computer.
no_model_hint: No recognition model is selected on the computer. The audio is kept: choose a model and retry the message.
draft_hint: The take has not been sent yet.
uploading_hint: Audio is going to the computer.
queued_hint: Waiting to be transcribed on the computer.
no_monologs: No monologs yet. Create the first one and dictate into it.
busy_hint: The engine is busy on the computer — transcription continues when it is free.
offline_recording: The computer is not answering — check that the Voice Button app is running. The recording is kept
record_offline: No connection — the recording is kept and transcribed when it returns
archive_read_only: An archived monolog cannot be changed or recorded into. Take it out of the archive first.
